LOCAL GOVERNMENT ROUNDUP

Area boards met this week on a mix of zoning, infrastructure, and school finance matters, though outcomes for most meetings were not yet confirmed at press time.

  • The Wausau School Board is set to approve its 2026-2027 budget and tax levy, built around a 4.03% estimated increase in equalized property values.
  • The Kronenwetter Village Board is set to vote on a zoning change for a Lea Road property and consider a state pollutant-discharge memorandum of agreement.
  • The Kronenwetter Village Board is also set to appoint an interim clerk and establish an interim wage at its Monday meeting.
  • The Kronenwetter Plan Commission is set to take up a conditional use permit and site plan for a Marathon County highway facility, plus a text amendment to allow zero-lot-line homes.
  • The Kronenwetter Parks Committee is set to review a zipline proposal for Friendship Park and discuss fundraising bricks and signage for Buska Park.

Coming up: The week ahead is heavy with activity: the Wausau City Plan Commission meets Tuesday at 5 p.m., the DC Everest School Board holds its regular meeting Wednesday at 6:30 p.m., and Marathon County's HR, Finance & Property Committee convenes Thursday at 5 p.m., the same evening as the Wausau Transit Commission and a second Kronenwetter Village Board meeting.
